newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Registrar urges NZ companies to re-register.
newsitem.headline: Registrar urges NZ companies to re-register.

text.p: The Companies Office on Tuesday issued a hurry-up call to companies required to re-register under the Companies Act 1993 by the end of June.
Registrar of Companies Neville Harris said only 21,350 or 15 percent of companies registered under the old Companies Act 1955 had re-registered voluntarily ahead of the deadline on June 30.

Companies had three years to re-register and if they failed to apply by the deadline they would be deemed to be re-registered on July 1, a process that causes the existing constitution of a company to become ineffective.
Harris said he was concerned that so many companies were leaving re-registration to the last minute.
